title: Final Potentials Inside
description: Essential Criteria: The potential inside the sphere must be correctly stated as Phi_1 = q/(4 pi epsilon_0 a).

title: Final Potentials Outside
description: Essential Criteria: The potential outside the sphere must be correctly stated as Phi_2 = -E_0 r cos(theta) + q/(4 pi epsilon_0 r) + E_0 a^3/r^2 cos(theta).

title: Dipole Moment
description: Essential Criteria: The dipole moment of the induced charge must be correctly identified as P = 4 pi epsilon_0 a^3 E_0.

title: Energy Terms Identification
description: Important Criteria: The six energy terms must be correctly identified and categorized as finite or infinite.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The boundary conditions for the potentials at the sphere's surface must be correctly applied.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the calculations, particularly for energy terms.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes in energy terms or missing factors must be avoided.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: Discussion of limiting cases or special scenarios should be included for completeness.
